title: HELIX 2.0
author: Majestic-Solution677
selftext: I've been working on a Godot port of the board game in working on and I think it overall looks way better than the html version, still working with Fable 5

comments.author: Desperate-Storm-7085
comments.body: This is so cool! what did you use to make the tiles so orderly?

replies.author: Majestic-Solution677
replies.body: So there's a term called tessellate that applies to a number of geometrical shapes and puts them together in order, if you're working with Fable or anything similar you can ask him to build the pieces so they tessellate, this way each piece is individual and not a grid over a field allowing stuff like the "closing" circle on my game for example

replies.author: MunchyCerealGuy
replies.body:
Thanks, I will remember this

i'd totally forgotten about tessellations. Kind of amazing that humans have been working out these patterns since ancient tilework from 4000 BC, and now all that art history turns out to be perfect vocabulary for prompting machines to do it. I've got to consume more art!!

replies.author: Majestic-Solution677
replies.body: Yeah and unless you're presented with such problems it's not quite common, except this one song from alt-J that's called tessellate

comments.author: CodexPleaseReset
comments.body:
Just a few tips that I know you didn't ask for so apologies in advance if unwarranted:
- I tried to play on my desktop Chrome browser just now, but some buttons aren't appearing on-screen. The scroll bar works, but being able to scroll with my trackpad or mouse wheel would be nice.
- I am also locked out of using F11 to go fullscreen; I find it's nice when the UI is responsive to either fullscreen or non-fullscreen
- Those were my impressions just on the landing page specifically. I see that you do have mousewheel enabled on the tiled map itself which is nice.
- I can't really figure out how to play or what the objectives are. I made one move and then got stuck

replies.author: Majestic-Solution677
replies.body:
This feedback is genuinely appreciated, I'm adding a tutorial in the next release,

About the UI not being responsive in fullscreen I haven't tested it so far with "browser" full screen I'll definitely look into it.

the objective is to defeat all opponents in the current version, to move an unit you have to tap said unit ( your units blink at the start of the turn) then it shows the movement range, the units have different ranges and resistance/weaknesses 

Is very likely you didn't ended your turn, I need to make that more self understanding.

Feel free to share any other suggestions I really appreciate you taking your time to try it

replies.author: CodexPleaseReset
replies.body: Please @ me when you've made some updates and I'd be happy to play again. Art looks good and concept seems fun. Props to you for posting your game! More than I have ever done or will do, under this account at least
